supporting_source_lines.text: Fine-grained factuality assessment motivates separating supported units from unsupported ones. FActScore decomposes generations into atomic facts and estimates their support \cite{factscore}; AlignScore learns an alignment function for factual-consistency assessment \cite{alignscore}. Our simpler sentence proxies are not atomic facts, and our logistic risk score is not an estimate of the proportion of true facts. The NLI checkpoints used here are existing cross-encoders trained for contradiction, entailment, and neutral prediction \cite{smallcard,basecard}. Their outputs require evaluation in the downstream detection task.
